transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I think what finally brought me in is that I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to always make time for things I enjoyed—painting, hiking, my choir... even the Sunday family gatherings. But lately, even when I have a free hour to do something, I just sit there. I just can't seem to care about any of it anymore.
Have you noticed a change in how much you enjoy activities, like painting, hiking, or spending time with your family?

Yes, exactly like I was just saying. The enjoyment is just... gone. I used to really look forward to all of those things, but now there's just no interest there at all. Even if I have the time to paint or see my family, I just sit there. I just don't care about doing any of it anymore.
Is it that you no longer feel pleasure or satisfaction from most activities that you used to enjoy, even when you do them?

Yes, that's it exactly. Like I was just saying, even if I force myself to go to the Sunday gatherings or try to paint, I don't get any satisfaction from it anymore. I just sit there. It's like... I just can't care about it, even when I'm right in the middle of doing it. 

That's really what finally brought me in to see you. I just don't feel like myself when all those things I used to make time for feel completely empty to me now.
Have you noticed feeling down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yes, pretty much every day. It feels like there's this heavy gray film over everything. I can be at work, standing in a classroom full of my students, or just at home with my husband, and I still feel completely hollow. I just feel close to tears most of the time.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been building for a while now... about eight months, I'd say. It really started around the time I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative at work.
Have you noticed that you feel unusually tired or that you've been lacking energy lately, even when you haven't been doing anything physically demanding?

No, not really. I mean, I'm tired at the end of the day, but just the normal amount, I think. I haven't noticed feeling unusually exhausted or like I have no energy, especially if I haven't been doing much.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you're failing others more often lately, or feeling like you're not worth much?

Yes, actually, I do. Whenever anything goes wrong with that curriculum project I mentioned... even if it's just something small, I keep thinking I'm completely letting the students down. And then my mind just goes to, well, I start feeling like I'm wasting all the sacrifices my parents made for me to even have this kind of opportunity. I just feel like I'm failing everybody.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or focusing on tasks, like planning lessons or following conversations, since you've been feeling this way?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had any issues with that. I mean... I can still focus on my work and follow what the teachers or students are saying just fine. Getting things organized hasn't been a problem. My concentration seems pretty normal, honestly.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining a significant amount of weight?

No, my appetite has been pretty normal. I'm eating about the same amount I always do, and I haven't noticed any changes in my weight either. My clothes still fit the same, so I don't think there's been any significant gain or loss.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or found yourself restless and unable to sit still lately?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I think I'm moving around at my normal pace. I haven't felt restless or fidgety either... I can sit still just fine when I need to. So, no, no changes there.
Have you ever felt this way before, with similar feelings of sadness and loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

No, not really. I mean... everyone gets sad sometimes or has a bad week, but nothing like this. This is definitely the first time I've felt this down for so long, and just... disconnected from things. So, yeah, I haven't really experienced anything like this before.
Have you had any thoughts about death, dying, or ending your life since you've been feeling this way?

Well, yes. Sometimes on late nights when I'm in the studio, I... I catch myself thinking that it would just be a relief if I didn't wake up. I haven't made a plan to actually do anything, but honestly, those thoughts scare me. They scared me enough that I finally told my husband about it, because I realized I just couldn't keep handling them alone.
Before this current period, have you ever had an episode where you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?
No, like I mentioned just a minute ago, I really haven't. I've never had a time where I felt this down for two weeks straight before. This is definitely the first time it's ever been like this.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, even if others around you thought it was out of the ordinary?
No, I haven't. I've never really been the type to feel unusually high or overly energetic like that. I'm usually pretty even-keeled, so... no, nothing like what you're describing.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt down or lost interest in things before this current episode, even if it wasn’t as severe as what you’re experiencing now?

No, like I just mentioned a minute ago, I really haven't. Even if it was a milder version... no, I've just never gone through a period like this before. This is definitely the first time I've ever felt this way.
Have you ever experienced a time before this when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?

I think you might have just asked me that... but no, I really haven't. The answer is still no. I've never had a time where I felt like this for two weeks before now. This whole thing is completely new to me.
